scenarios.title: A state branch with exactly 14 digits is classified as state
scenarios.notes: Try sdlc/state-20261008101500 through parse and the CLI. ts must stay a string. Try 13 and 15 digits, an empty tail, a letter among the digits, and a trailing letter. All of these must give null. Try a trailing newline and non-ASCII digits: report them as seeds, S-007 left them open.

scenarios.title: A verify branch splits into id, round, profile and part
scenarios.notes: Try S-001-v0-http-api-0 and S-001-v12-cli-3: round and part are integers. Profile a-b-c keeps its full text. Missing part digit, missing round or empty profile must not give verify. Hostile input: huge round digits, flag-like and control-character ids, NUL, oversized tails. Parse must return a value or null and never raise.

scenarios.title: A verify tail wins over the slice row
scenarios.notes: S-001-v0-http-api-0 also fits the slice regex. It must give kind verify. S-fix-M-1-2-v1-cli-0 gives id S-fix-M-1-2. Check the same order with prefix and suffix formats.

scenarios.title: An attempt branch gives id and an integer n
scenarios.notes: Try S-001-attempt-2 and S-005b-attempt-10. Missing number, letter number and trailing hyphen must not give attempt. Check that attempt wins over the slice row, and that a verify-shaped tail still gives verify before attempt.

scenarios.title: A slice branch gives kind slice and keeps the full id
scenarios.notes: Try S-001, S-fix-M-1-2 and S-005b. sdlc/S-, sdlc/X-001 and sdlc/S-001/x give null. sdlc/s-001 is null under the default format and slice under {name:lower}.

scenarios.title: Rows 5 to 8 classify the same under prefixed and suffixed formats
scenarios.notes: Run one branch per row under feature/PROJ-1-{name} and {name}-wip. The suffix must not leak into the verify part or the attempt n. A branch with a wrong prefix or suffix gives null.

scenarios.title: The ledger flag known follows the id on rows 6 to 8
scenarios.notes: With ids [S-001], slice, attempt and verify branches of S-001 give known true. S-002 gives false. A state branch gives null. Under {name:lower}, a mixed-case id still matches and returns the ledger spelling.

tools.purpose: Call parse through the Python probe for each row, including seeded generated tails, and check that it never raises.
Run branches.py parse from a scratch repo and compare kind and parts with the contract result.
Feed unicode-digits, huge-integers, nul, oversized, control-chars and flag-like-values tails into the verify, attempt and state rows.

riskReason: Row order decides how scripts classify state, verify and slice branches, so a wrong order makes them sweep or resume the wrong branch.
notes: Slice adds tests only. S-007 built the rows. Tagged contract first, then cli, then security, within the medium cap of 4. The limits profile is not tagged: the spec states no number. Huge digit runs and trailing newline stay as seeds from S-007.
